pairs.target: dìsìtiān zǎochén , tǎ wéi zài qǐn fángménkǒu děng yīwén .
pairs.english: On the fourth morning, Tavi waited for Iven outside the dorm room.
pairs.hanzi: 第四天早晨，塔维在寝房门口等伊文。

pairs.target: zuówǎn tì pà wò fèng qiú , tā bǎ bù kǒu shōu dé tàijǐn , qiú de yícè gǔ chū yígèbāo .
pairs.english: Mending Pavo's ball last night, he had gathered the opening too tightly, leaving a bulge on one side.
pairs.hanzi: 昨晚替帕沃缝球，他把布口收得太紧，球的一侧鼓出一个包。

pairs.target: pà wò shì zhe zài dìshàng gǔn le yìhuí , shuō xiàng tiáo bǒ tuǐ gǒu , háishì gāogāoxìngxìng dì shōu jìn le chuángdǐ .
pairs.english: Pavo tried rolling it on the floor, said it resembled a limping dog, and happily put it under his bed anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃试着在地上滚了一回，说像条跛腿狗，还是高高兴兴地收进了床底。

pairs.target: xiànzài tǎ wéi shǒulǐ méiyǒu qiú , zhǐyǒu juàn hǎo de túzhǐ .
pairs.english: Now Tavi held no ball, only rolled-up drawing paper.
pairs.hanzi: 现在塔维手里没有球，只有卷好的图纸。

pairs.target: jīntiānshàngwǔ yào huà zhī bì , zuótiān lǐng lái de zhǐ zài chuáng xiàfàng le yíyè , biānjiǎo bèi tā yòng xié yāpíng le .
pairs.english: This morning they would draw a support arm. Yesterday's paper had spent the night under his bed, its edges flattened with his shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 今天上午要画支臂，昨天领来的纸在床下放了一夜，边角被他用鞋压平了。

pairs.target: yīwén zǒulái shí hái zài kòu xiùzǐ , wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu chī zǎofàn .
pairs.english: Iven came over still fastening his cuffs and asked whether he'd had breakfast.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文走来时还在扣袖子，问他有没有吃早饭。

pairs.target: liǎng rén qù fàntáng fēn le zuìhòu yìdié xiáncài , gǎn zài língshēng qiánjìn le huìtúshì .
pairs.english: They shared the last dish of pickles at the dining hall and reached the drawing room before the bell.
pairs.hanzi: 两人去饭堂分了最后一碟咸菜，赶在铃声前进了绘图室。

pairs.target: chángzhuō zhōngyāng bǎi zhe yì jié mùjià .
pairs.english: A section of wooden frame stood in the middle of the long table.
pairs.hanzi: 长桌中央摆着一截木架。

pairs.target: yìgēn duǎn bì yòng tiě xiāo lián zài lìzhù shàng , nénggòu shàngxià zhuàndòng ; xié chēng cóng dǐxià tuōzhù duǎn bì , chēng jiǎo chājìn dǐzuò de cáo lǐ .
pairs.english: A short arm was joined to an upright with an iron pin and could pivot up and down; a diagonal brace supported it from below, its foot slotted into the base.
pairs.hanzi: 一根短臂用铁销连在立柱上，能够上下转动；斜撑从底下托住短臂，撑脚插进底座的槽里。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī xiān bákāi xié chēng , ràng dàjiā kàn duǎn bì zěnyàng chuí xià , yòu bǎ tā zhī huí yuánchù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey first removed the brace to show everyone how the arm dropped, then propped it back up.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师先拔开斜撑，让大家看短臂怎样垂下，又把它支回原处。

pairs.target: " jīntiān bú jiè xìng . bǎ tā huà qīngchǔ , ràng gébì wū de rén zhào zhezhuāng dé qǐlái . "
pairs.english: “No property borrowing today. Draw it clearly enough for someone in the next room to assemble it from your drawing.”
pairs.hanzi: “今天不借性。把它画清楚，让隔壁屋的人照着装得起来。”

pairs.target: tā fā xià chǐzi , yāoqiú měirén huà zìjǐ de , liáng de shíhòu kěyǐ lúnliú .
pairs.english: She handed out rulers and told them to make individual drawings, taking turns measuring.
pairs.hanzi: 她发下尺子，要求每人画自己的，量的时候可以轮流。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng qiánmiàn de rén fàngxià chǐ , cái shēnshǒu guòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for the person ahead to put down the ruler before reaching for it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等前面的人放下尺，才伸手过去。

pairs.target: tā jiàn guò lèishì de huòjià zhīchēng , xiān liáng xiāo kǒng dào bì duānde jùlí , yòu kàn cáokǒu yǒuduōshēn .
pairs.english: He had seen similar shelf supports; he first measured from the pin hole to the arm's end, then checked the depth of the slot.
pairs.hanzi: 他见过类似的货架支撑，先量销孔到臂端的距离，又看槽口有多深。

pairs.target: mùtou shàng jiù de mó hén gàosù tā , zhègēn xié chēng chājìnqù yǐhòu , hái huì wǎng lǐ zuò yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The old wear marks on the wood told him the brace would settle a little farther in after insertion.
pairs.hanzi: 木头上旧的磨痕告诉他，这根斜撑插进去以后，还会往里坐一点。

pairs.target: kě zhèxiē dōngxī dào le zhǐ shàng , jiù bùkěn dài zài gāi dài de dìfāng le .
pairs.english: But on paper, these things refused to stay where they belonged.
pairs.hanzi: 可这些东西到了纸上，就不肯待在该待的地方了。

pairs.target: tā huà de zhèngmiàn xiàng gè wāi dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: His front view looked like a crooked stool.
pairs.hanzi: 他画的正面像个歪凳子。

pairs.target: xié chēng dǎngzhù xiāo kǒng , tā nuókāi yìdiǎn , yòu ràng liǎnggēn mùtou xiàngshì bìngpái tiēzhe .
pairs.english: The brace obscured the pin hole; shifting it a little made the two pieces of wood look stuck side by side.
pairs.hanzi: 斜撑挡住销孔，他挪开一点，又让两根木头像是并排贴着。

pairs.target: kètáng shàng shuō guò de cèshì , tā jìde yìsī , luòbǐ shí réng bú quèdìng gāi cóng nǎ yìbiān kàn .
pairs.english: He remembered what “side view” meant from class, but with pen on paper he still wasn't sure which side to look from.
pairs.hanzi: 课堂上说过的侧视，他记得意思，落笔时仍不确定该从哪一边看。

pairs.target: yīwén zuòzài pángbiān , zhǐ shàng yǐyǒu liǎnggè zhěngqí de tú .
pairs.english: Beside him, Iven already had two neat drawings on his paper.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文坐在旁边，纸上已有两个整齐的图。

pairs.target: tā piē le yìyǎn , ná qǐ tǎ wéi gēxià de tànbǐ .
pairs.english: He glanced over and picked up the charcoal pencil Tavi had put down.
pairs.hanzi: 他瞥了一眼，拿起塔维搁下的炭笔。

pairs.target: " zhèlǐ xiě xiāo kǒng . zhège zì ——"
pairs.english: “Write ‘pin hole’ here. This character—”
pairs.hanzi: “这里写销孔。这个字——”

pairs.target: tā xiě dé kuài , kǒng zì zuìhòu yìbǐhuà jìn le tǎ wéi nàtiáo duǎn bì .
pairs.english: He wrote quickly; the last stroke of “hole” ran into Tavi's short arm.
pairs.hanzi: 他写得快，孔字最后一笔划进了塔维那条短臂。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu ànzhù zhǐ , yīwén de bǐjiān tíng le .
pairs.english: Tavi reached out to hold the paper down. Iven's pencil stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手按住纸，伊文的笔尖停了。

pairs.target: " wǒ háiyào gǎi . " " kěyǐ cā . " " nà nǐ xiān wèn wǒ . "
pairs.english: “I'm still changing it.” “It can be erased.” “Then ask me first.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我还要改。”
“可以擦。”
“那你先问我。”

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ bǐ fàng huíqù , shēngyīn yě dī le : " wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng bāng nǐ . "
pairs.english: Iven put the pencil back, his voice quieter too. “I only wanted to help.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把笔放回去，声音也低了：“我只是想帮你。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu huídá . tā zhīdào nà liǎnggè zì bǐ zìjǐ xiě dé hǎo , yuè zhīdào , liǎnshàng yuè rè .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't answer. He knew those two characters were better than his own, and knowing made his face burn hotter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有回答。他知道那两个字比自己写得好，越知道，脸上越热。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài duìmiàn tái le yíxiàtóu , shǒulǐ de chǐzi hái yā zhe zìjǐ de tú .
pairs.english: Mira looked up across the table, her ruler still pressed against her own drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在对面抬了一下头，手里的尺子还压着自己的图。

pairs.target: " shuí liáng guò dǐzuò ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Who measured the base?” she asked.
pairs.hanzi: “谁量过底座？”她问。

pairs.target: yīwén bào le gèshù . tā méi tīng qīng , ràng tā zàishuō yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Iven gave a number. She hadn't heard clearly and asked him to repeat it.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文报了个数。她没听清，让他再说一遍。

pairs.target: zhuōbiān chóngxīn yǒu le chǐzi pèng mùtou de shēngyīn , tǎ wéi què juéde zìjǐ gāngcái nàjùhuà hái gē zài zhōngjiān , shuí shēnshǒu dōu dé ràoguòqù .
pairs.english: Rulers tapped wood around the table again, but Tavi felt his words still lay in the middle, forcing every reaching hand to go around them.
pairs.hanzi: 桌边重新有了尺子碰木头的声音，塔维却觉得自己刚才那句话还搁在中间，谁伸手都得绕过去。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zǒu dào tā shēnhòu , ná qǐ tā de zhǐ , zhuǎn le bànquān .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey came behind him, picked up his paper, and turned it halfway around.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师走到他身后，拿起他的纸，转了半圈。

pairs.target: " nǐ dǎsuàn ràng xié chēng cóng nǎbiān jìnqù ? "
pairs.english: “Which side are you planning to insert the brace from?”
pairs.hanzi: “你打算让斜撑从哪边进去？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐzhuó shíwù shuō cóng zhèlǐ , xiǎng bǎ zhǐ jiēhuílái huà gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi pointed at the frame and said, “Here,” wanting the paper back to draw it for her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维指着实物说从这里，想把纸接回来画给她看。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu sōngshǒu , zhīyòng lìngyìzhī shǒu ànzhù mùjià .
pairs.english: She didn't let go, only held the frame with her other hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有松手，只用另一只手按住木架。

pairs.target: " xiān ná chūlái , zài zhuāng yícì . "
pairs.english: “Take it out first. Then fit it again.”
pairs.hanzi: “先拿出来，再装一次。”

pairs.target: tā chōuchū xié chēng , táiqǐ duǎn bì , zhào yuányàng fàng huí cáo lǐ .
pairs.english: He pulled out the brace, lifted the short arm, and replaced it in the slot as before.
pairs.hanzi: 他抽出斜撑，抬起短臂，照原样放回槽里。

pairs.target: tā kàn le yíbiàn , bǎ tú háigěi tā .
pairs.english: She watched once, then gave him back the drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了一遍，把图还给他。

pairs.target: " zhuāng dé duì . tú shàng kànbùchūlái . lìng huà cèmiàn , bié wǎng zhè yìtuán lǐ tiān le . "
pairs.english: “You've assembled it right. The drawing doesn't show it. Make a separate side view; don't add to this tangle.”
pairs.hanzi: “装得对。图上看不出来。另画侧面，别往这一团里添了。”

pairs.target: tā zhuǎn qù kàn yīwén de . yīwén yǐjīng zuò zhí , wéi lǎoshī què bǎ chǐzi héng zài tā liǎngzhāng tú zhījiān .
pairs.english: She turned to Iven's. He sat up straight, but Instructor Vey laid the ruler across his two drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 她转去看伊文的。伊文已经坐直，维老师却把尺子横在他两张图之间。

pairs.target: " zhè liǎnggè dǐzuò , búshì tóngyígè kuāndù . "
pairs.english: “These two bases aren't the same width.”
pairs.hanzi: “这两个底座，不是同一个宽度。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn , suíjí qù zhǎo gāngcái jì de shùzì . zhǐ jiǎo fān qǐlái , dǐxià háiyǒu yìháng bèi zìjǐ mǒ huā de zì .
pairs.english: He looked down, then searched for the figures he'd noted. The paper corner curled up; beneath it was another line he'd smudged himself.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看，随即去找刚才记的数字。纸角翻起来，底下还有一行被自己抹花的字。

pairs.target: xiàkè qián , tǎ wéi zhī wánchéng le bànzhāng cèshìtú .
pairs.english: By the end of class, Tavi had finished only half a side view.
pairs.hanzi: 下课前，塔维只完成了半张侧视图。

pairs.target: qítārén juànzhǐ de shíhòu , tā réng dīng zhe nàgēn duǎn bì .
pairs.english: While the others rolled up their papers, he was still staring at the short arm.
pairs.hanzi: 其他人卷纸的时候，他仍盯着那根短臂。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuō xiàwǔ jiēzhe huà , ràng tāmen bǎ dōngxī liúzài zhuōshàng , bié jiá zài fànwǎn dǐxià dàizǒu .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey said they would continue that afternoon and should leave their things on the table, not take them away under their bowls.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说下午接着画，让他们把东西留在桌上，别夹在饭碗底下带走。

pairs.target: yīwén qǐshēn yào zǒu , tǎ wéi jiào le tā yìshēng .
pairs.english: Iven rose to leave, and Tavi called to him.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文起身要走，塔维叫了他一声。

pairs.target: " nǐ néng zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn ma ? " yīwén kàn le kàn zhuōshàng de bǐ , méiyǒu ná .
pairs.english: “Can you show me?” Iven glanced at the pencil on the table without picking it up.
pairs.hanzi:
“你能指给我看吗？”
伊文看了看桌上的笔，没有拿。

pairs.target: " zhǐ nǎér ? " " cóng zhè yìbiān kàn , xiāo kǒng gāi zài shénme dìfāng . xiān bié huà . "
pairs.english: “Show you what?” “Where the pin hole goes, viewed from this side. Don't draw yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
“指哪儿？”
“从这一边看，销孔该在什么地方。先别画。”

pairs.target: yīwén rào dào mùjià cèmiàn , dūnxiàlái , bǎ yìzhī yǎn bì shàng .
pairs.english: Iven went around to the frame's side, crouched down, and closed one eye.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文绕到木架侧面，蹲下来，把一只眼闭上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě dūnxiàqù , liǎng rén de jiānbǎng jǐ zài zhuōtuǐ páng .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched too, their shoulders pressed together by the table leg.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也蹲下去，两人的肩膀挤在桌腿旁。

pairs.target: nàge kǒng bèi duǎn bì zhēzhù le , zhī lùchū xiāodīng yuányuánde tóu .
pairs.english: The hole was hidden by the short arm; only the pin's round head showed.
pairs.hanzi: 那个孔被短臂遮住了，只露出销钉圆圆的头。

pairs.target: " yuánlái búyòng huà nàge quān . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “So I don't need that circle,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “原来不用画那个圈。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " kànbújiàn de yào yòng xūxiàn . lǎoshī gāngcái huà zài bǎn shàng le . "
pairs.english: “Hidden parts use dashed lines. The teacher just drew it on the board.”
pairs.hanzi: “看不见的要用虚线。老师刚才画在板上了。”

pairs.target: tā táitóu zhǎo hēibǎn , yīwén yòng shǒuzhǐ gěi tā kàn . zhèhuí zhǐ de shì bǎn , méiyǒu pèng tā de zhǐ .
pairs.english: He looked up for the board, and Iven pointed it out. This time he pointed at the board without touching Tavi's paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头找黑板，伊文用手指给他看。这回指的是板，没有碰他的纸。

pairs.target: mǐlā bào zhe shuǐbēi zǒu dào ménkǒu , huítóu wèn tāmen dàodǐ chī bu chīfàn .
pairs.english: Mira carried her cup to the door and turned to ask whether they were actually coming to eat.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抱着水杯走到门口，回头问他们到底吃不吃饭。

alignment.english: whether they were actually coming to eat

pairs.target: yīwén zhàn dé tài jí , hòunǎosháo zhuàng shàngzhuō yán , xiǎng dé shífēn qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Iven stood too quickly and hit the back of his head on the table edge with a distinctly audible knock.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文站得太急，后脑勺撞上桌沿，响得十分清楚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn nuókāi , ràng tā chūlái . yīwén wǔzhe nǎodài , bàntiān méi shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Tavi quickly moved aside to let him out. Iven held his head and said nothing for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧挪开，让他出来。伊文捂着脑袋，半天没说话。

pairs.target: " huàtú de shíhòu , " mǐlā shuō , " jì zhe bǎ zhuōzi huà gāo yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “When you draw it,” Mira said, “remember to make the table a little taller.”
pairs.hanzi: “画图的时候，”米拉说，“记着把桌子画高一点。”

pairs.target: yīwén dèng tā , tā yǐjīng zhuǎnguòshēn , jiānbǎng yì dǒu yi dǒu de .
pairs.english: Iven glared at her, but she had already turned away, shoulders shaking.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文瞪她，她已经转过身，肩膀一抖一抖的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu bǎ yǐzi tuīhuí zhuōxià , děng zìjǐ bú xiào le , cái gēn chūqù .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down and pushed his chair under the table, waiting until he stopped laughing before following them out.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头把椅子推回桌下，等自己不笑了，才跟出去。
